welcome.title.description: Title of the welcome page shown after sign-up, in the browser tab.

welcome.heading.description: Heading of the welcome page after sign-up. {server} is the name of the server.

welcome.lead.defaultMessage: Configure o básico do seu perfil e depois escolha pessoas para seguir na sua linha do tempo inicial.
welcome.lead.description: The line under the welcome heading that says what comes next.

welcome.basics.description: Heading of the section with the avatar and the display name on the welcome page.

welcome.basics.description.defaultMessage: Você pode alterar isso e adicionar uma bio depois, nas configurações do perfil.
welcome.basics.description.description: Note under the heading of the profile basics on the welcome page.

welcome.avatar.choose.description: Button that opens the file picker for the avatar on the welcome page.

welcome.avatar.remove.description: Button that removes the chosen avatar on the welcome page.

welcome.display_name.description: Label of the display name field on the welcome page.

welcome.display_name.description.defaultMessage: O nome que as pessoas veem. Deixe vazio para mostrar seu nome de usuário, {username}.
welcome.display_name.description.description: Help text of the display name field on the welcome page. {username} is the user's username.

welcome.continue.description: Primary button of the welcome page: saves the profile basics and opens the home timeline.

welcome.later.description: Link on the welcome page that opens the home timeline without saving.
